hero_lead: From day-to-day bookkeeping to year-end statements and strategic advice. Choose what you need, or let us handle it all.

services.title: Bookkeeping & Accounting
services.short: Monthly processing, bank and creditor reconciliations, and cloud accounting set-up on Xero, Sage or QuickBooks.
services.long: Accurate, up-to-date books are the foundation of every good decision. We process your transactions every month, keep your accounts reconciled and make sure your records are ready whenever you, SARS or your bank need them.
items: Monthly processing of income and expenses
Cloud accounting set-up and migration (Xero, Sage, QuickBooks)
Chart of accounts set-up and clean-up
Catch-up bookkeeping when records have fallen behind

services.title: Payroll Services
services.short: Payslips, leave, UIF and SDL, EMP201 and EMP501 submissions and IRP5 certificates, accurate and on time.
services.long: Paying your team correctly and on time, and keeping SARS and the Department of Employment and Labour satisfied, takes care every month. We run your payroll and handle the submissions for you.
items: Paperwork for new starters and terminations

services.title: Tax & SARS Compliance
services.short: VAT, PAYE, provisional and income tax returns for companies and individuals, plus SARS correspondence on your behalf.
services.long: Tax deadlines and SARS requirements change often. We prepare and submit your returns accurately and on time, and we deal with SARS for you so you don't have to.

services.title: Annual Financial Statements
services.short: Compiled AFS under IFRS for SMEs, with independent review arranged through trusted partners where required.
services.long: Your annual financial statements tell the story of your year, for SARS, your bank, investors and your own planning. We compile clear, compliant statements prepared under IFRS for SMEs.
items: Independent review arranged through trusted partners where required
Supporting schedules and year-end working papers
Figures ready for your annual tax return

services.title: Management Accounts & Reporting
services.short: Monthly management packs, key performance indicators and cash-flow tracking that show how the business is doing.
services.long: Management accounts show you how the business is really doing, not just once a year. We prepare a concise pack each month and walk you through what the numbers mean.
items: Monthly management pack (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow)
Key performance indicators that matter to your business

services.title: Business Advisory
services.short: Budgets, forecasts and cash-flow planning, plus start-up and registration support from day one.
services.long: Growing a business means making decisions with confidence. We help you plan ahead, prepare for the unexpected and set up your company properly from the start.
items: Financial information for bank and funding applications

services.title: CIPC & Secretarial
services.short: Company registrations, CIPC annual returns and beneficial ownership filings, so your company stays in good standing.
services.long: Keeping your company in good standing with the CIPC is a legal requirement. We handle the filings and changes, and remind you before anything is due.

engagement.title: Monthly retainer
engagement.text: Your complete, ongoing finance function for a fixed monthly fee agreed upfront.
engagement.best: Best for businesses that want a dependable finance department.

engagement.title: Once-off projects
engagement.text: Specific pieces of work, scoped and quoted upfront before we begin.
engagement.best: Best for a defined task with a clear end point.

engagement.title: Ad-hoc advisory
engagement.text: Qualified input when you need it, for a decision, a SARS letter or a plan.
items: A second opinion on your numbers
engagement.best: Best for owners who want expert advice on demand.

cta_title: Not sure which service you need?
cta_text: Tell us about your business in a free consultation and we'll recommend the right mix, with a clear fixed fee.
